# Why did my Salesforce lead import reject rows or create duplicates?

> Catch what makes Salesforce reject or duplicate imported leads, with the line number, before you run the import. Nothing leaves your device.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
